text.plain: This Ring of Elemental Command is linked to the Elemental Plane of Earth. While wearing it, you have Advantage on attack rolls against Elementals and they have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. You know Terran and have Resistance to Acid damage. Rubble, rocks, and dirt aren't Difficult Terrain for you, and the ring grants its printed earth-gliding property. Its Elemental Compulsion has save DC 18. The ring has 5 charges, regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn, and casts its printed earth spells at save DC 18.
